messages:
Marta (AE): Quick sync on the Thorn pilot — final readout is tomorrow. Need final metrics, remaining blockers, and a clear expansion ask. Can SEs confirm success criteria mapping and final numbers? POC ran for 2 weeks. Objectives we agreed on: reduce triage time by >=30%, p95 latency < 400ms, reranker false-positive rate < 8%, data residency must be cleared. @Liam @Nora @Annie

Liam (SE): On it. I'm compiling the evals and server-side metrics now, will post a short summary here in the next hour.

Nora (Solutions Eng): FYI — we changed batching config in week 2 (lower batch timeout) which improved avg latency but slightly increased token cost. That could affect per-token cost numbers in the readout.

Annie (CS): CS note — customer cares most about: 1) latency (p50/p95), 2) precision@3 for reranker, 3) confirmation on data residency + KMS. Raj, can you confirm retention/KMS options?

Raj (SRE): Logs and retention: Dedicated default retention = 30d. Customer asked for 180d — needs ops approval and cost estimate. KMS: we support BYOK for Private/Dedicated; Hosted has sealed keys + audit logs. I'll prepare a short blurb for the readout.

Liam (SE): Posting the run summary we pulled from eval infra:

```
run_summary:
  avg_latency_ms: 210
  p95_latency_ms: 380
  triage_time_reduction_pct: 33
  reranker_fp_rate_pct: 9.2
  tokens_generated: 1234567
```

Liam (SE): Notes on metrics: triage reduction measured via sample of 200 tickets; reranker FP is 9.2% (over target). p95 under threshold but FP is just above the 8% success criteria.

Nora (Solutions Eng): FP = 9.2% — failure modes: ambiguous prompts and some edge-case long contexts. Short-term mitigation: increase reranker beam to 5, add a lightweight heuristic to filter ambiguous queries, and bump prefix cache TTL for top queries. I can push a patch and re-run the evals tomorrow.

Marta (AE): If FP stays above 8% after fixes, what's our ask? Extended pilot? Pricing concession? Dedicated pilot? Need a concrete expansion proposal.

Liam (SE): Recommend: 6-week focused extension (model tuning + prompt engineering) + temporary discount on Dedicated reserved pricing during extension. Ops needs to provide cost delta. This gives time to get FP under 8% with real traffic.

Annie (CS): Customer is open to an extended pilot as long as we commit to weekly checkpoints and concrete success gates. They also pushed on security questionnaire item Q7 (key management) — Raj's blurb should cover that.

Raj (SRE): I'll attach KMS wording and note the audit log entries. For 180d retention we need a cost estimate and approval — I'll add that to the doc. Also: Private deployment path adds ~8-10 weeks lead time.

Marta (AE): Action items (quick):
- Liam: final metrics doc + single-page run summary
- Nora: top 10 prompt failure examples + suggested prompt patches and quick mitigation PR
- Raj: KMS/retention blurb + cost estimate for 180d retention
- Annie: confirm readout agenda with customer and lock 30-min slot
- Marta: draft expansion proposal + pricing options

deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled deployment to staging at 18:00 UTC today — should not affect production but heads up in case anyone is iterating on the patch.

Liam (SE): Final metrics doc posted: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/THORN-POC-RESULTS (internal). Example eval query I used: `SELECT * FROM evals WHERE pilot = 'thorn' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50;`

Nora (Solutions Eng): :thumbsup: I'll follow up with a tiny eval harness change to re-run on trimmed ambiguous prompts. Expect results by tomorrow AM.

Annie (CS): Readout agenda locked: 30m total — 10m metrics, 10m demo, 10m next steps. Can we have a single 'next steps' slide with pricing + timeline? @Marta

Marta (AE): Yes. Pricing ask I'm preparing: 3-month Dedicated pilot at ~60% list + performance SLAs, and an alternative: 6-week extension on Hosted with model tuning at a smaller discount. I'll put numbers in the deck.

Raj (SRE): For compliance: need customer's SOC2 scope and SIEM contact to wire up audit log forwarding. Also flag: 180d retention will add storage cost — I'll estimate and include it.

Marta (AE): Great. I'll consolidate everything into one slide deck and share by EOD so we can rehearse. If anything blocks or you need a live demo machine, ping here. :rocket:

Annie (CS): Thanks all — I'll confirm the readout time with the customer and send calendar invite once deck is ready.

Liam (SE): One last note — if we accept the extension, we should lock a canary/QA plan: weekly eval run + KPI gate to determine go/no-go at week 3. I'll draft that section.

Marta (AE): Perfect. Week 3 gate and weekly checkpoints in the slide. Thanks team.
